title: Practice 4: Particles: же, ведь, разве, неужели, даже

blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: Even from afar, you can tell it's him just by the shape of his body and his clothes.

exercises.q: Из Назарета ___ (мочь + ли) быть что доброе?
exercises.prompt: Nazareth! Can anything good come from there?
exercises.why: «The particle ЛИ never begins the clause; it takes the second place in the clause following the word to which the question or doubt refers.» — DLI, Lesson 91. Sentence and translation from Tatoeba (CC BY 2.0 FR).
